lal_sacristan.text: The town is named for the Immaculate Conception, and her feast day, the eighth of December, is a holiday all over Spain. Here it's ours twice over.

Semana Santa, Holy Week, is the big one in Andalusia: brotherhoods carry great floats of the Virgin through the streets at night, very slowly, to drums. Even the people who never come to Mass come to watch.

lal_bride.text: My grandparents married here in 1971, the year the frontier was shut. Half the family watched from the other side of the fence. They waved the whole way through the vows.
